title: StayInGame
description: StayInGame blocks the Windows key and Alt+Tab while Minecraft is focused, preventing accidental exits from fullscreen during game focus. Fully toggleable via hotkeys or an in-game menu (Mod Menu support included).
body:
# StayInGame

Blocks the **Windows key** and **Alt+Tab** while Minecraft is focused, so you don't
accidentally get kicked out of fullscreen during intense moments.

## Features
- Independent toggles for Windows key blocking and Alt+Tab blocking
- Two hotkeys (default **F8** / **F9**) to toggle each on/off during gameplay
- ActionBar feedback (green = enabled, red = disabled)
- Optional [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) integration with an in-game settings screen
- Localized: English, German, Austrian German, Swiss German

## Requirements
- Fabric API
- **Windows only** — uses a native Windows API hook, has no effect on macOS/Linux

## Configuration
Rebind the toggle hotkeys under Options → Controls → StayInGame, or open the
settings screen from Mod Menu if installed.
